programmes.name_local: الصندوق الوطني لرعاية وتنمية المشروعات الصغيرة والمتوسطة
programmes.name_en: Kuwait National Fund for SME Development financing
programmes.funder: National Fund for Small and Medium Enterprise Development (Kuwait)
programmes.amount_note: The fund finances up to 80% of an approved project's capital, historically capped at KWD 500,000 per project, with the Kuwaiti founder contributing the remaining share.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications through the National Fund portal; the fund has periodically paused intake for particular activity categories.
programmes.reopen_note: The National Fund periodically revises its list of eligible activities and can suspend intake in oversubscribed categories; check nationalfund.gov.kw for currently accepted activity codes.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the National Fund portal with a Kuwaiti civil ID.
Complete the training and business plan requirements.
Committee review, then financing agreement and staged disbursement.

eligibility.other_note: Restricted to Kuwaiti nationals; the founder must dedicate themselves full time to the project and contribute at least 20% of capital.
